name: 52060 · Maquoketa, IA
findings: ZIP 52060 (Maquoketa) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (15%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 52060 (Maquoketa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
